name: ch46-1-gpt4-mirror
prompt: A friendly cartoon GPT-4 character holding a hand-mirror up to its own face, while simultaneously writing 5/5 Excellent on a clipboard with the other hand. A small caption banner above reads Self-Preference Bias In Action. Warm watercolor, gentle satirical tone, no other text. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch46-1-balance-judge
prompt: A cartoon judge in a wig holding a balance scale. Five small weights labelled Position, Length, Self-preference, Anchoring, Style are all stacked on the SAME side of the scale. The judge looks puzzled. Warm hand-drawn courtroom style, no other text. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch56-1-venn-buyers
prompt: A friendly Venn diagram cartoon. Three large overlapping circles labelled General Counsel, CDO, CISO. Each circle points to a different small cartoon platform icon: governance suite, observability dashboard, runtime guard. The three-way intersection in the middle is empty and labelled One Platform To Rule Them All (theoretical). Hand-drawn diagram, warm pastels, no other text. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch56-2-three-fairness-scales
prompt: Three small cartoon weighing scales on a counter, each labelled AIF360, Fairlearn, Aequitas. All three weigh the same little package labelled Dataset. The three readouts show 0.82, 0.83, 0.81 respectively. A confused engineer leans in with a magnifying glass. Warm watercolor. Aspect ratio 16:9. No other text.

name: ch59-5-3am-checkpoint
prompt: A cartoon training-cluster scene at 3am. One of many GPU servers is comically smoking. A small friendly robot labelled auto-checkpoint calmly carries the model state in a tiny treasure chest labelled S3 to safety. The on-call engineer stands nearby in pajamas with coffee, watching calmly. Warm watercolor, gentle nighttime palette. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch61-1-eth-vs-ib
prompt: Two cartoon GPU clusters side-by-side. Left: labelled Ethernet, with thin droopy wires connecting boxes, sad-faced GPUs achieving 30% MFU. Right: labelled InfiniBand, with thick glowing cables, happy GPUs at 60% MFU. Caption banner: Interconnect Is The Silent Multiplier. Warm hand-drawn cartoon. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch41-3-arena-wrestling
prompt: Two anonymized cartoon chatbot characters arm-wrestling on a small stage with masks labelled Model A and Model B. A crowd of cartoon humans below wearing blindfolds raises A and B paddles. A scoreboard at the side reads ELO 1230 vs 1228. Friendly arena scene, warm watercolor. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch41-4-voice-cascaded-vs-realtime
prompt: Telephone-call cartoon, split panel. Left robot labelled cascaded pipeline holds a tall stack of giant flash cards labelled STT, LLM, TTS and looks stressed. Right robot labelled GPT-4o Realtime sips coffee, relaxed, mid-sentence. A phone line connects them. Warm hand-drawn watercolor. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch24-13-snow-globe-dr
prompt: A snow globe containing a tiny robot arm on a table. A giant hand shakes it. Tiny labels float around inside the globe: lighting, friction, mass, camera_jitter. Outside the globe, a calm cartoon researcher holds a clipboard labelled Domain Randomization. Warm whimsical hand-drawn style. Aspect ratio 16:9.

name: ch29-1-self-debug-strip
prompt: Four-panel cartoon strip, warm hand-drawn style, white background. Panel 1: a friendly cartoon robot types code on a laptop. Panel 2: a tests window shows 3 RED, 2 GREEN; the robot frowns. Panel 3: the robot scratches its head while editing the code. Panel 4: the tests now show 5 GREEN; the robot lifts its arms in tiny triumph. No speech bubbles, gentle tone. Aspect ratio 16:9.
